title: Thai-Style Braised Lamb Tagine
description: A fragrant and flavorful Thai-inspired stew made with lamb shoulder, perfect for a cold evening. The use of wine and crisp spices gives it a unique twist.

ingredients.name: winey vinegar
ingredients.notes: or substitute with apple cider vinegar

ingredients.name: tagine spice blend
ingredients.notes: or substitute with a mix of cinnamon, cardamom, and ginger

instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add cumin seeds and cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add lamb shoulder and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add vinegar, coriander, and tagine spice blend. Stir to combine.
Add enough water to cover the lamb, then bring to a boil.
Cover the pot and transfer to the oven.
Braise the lamb for 2.5 hours, or until tender.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool slightly.
Shred the lamb with two forks and return it to the pot.
Simmer the stew over low heat for 10 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs, if desired.
